notes: Hooked. Recording vtable (slots 3,4,6,7,11,12,14) around the original slots so the call sequence, read bytes and results are compared: 351 narrow cases (random line lengths around 0x80/0x800, all terminator pairs, pre-open, pre-seek, scripted read failures) and 160 UTF-16 cases.
